title: AbFlowNet: Optimizing Antibody-Antigen Binding Energy via Diffusion-GFlowNet Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2505.12358v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Complementarity Determining Regions (CDRs) are critical segments of an antibody that facilitate binding to specific antigens. Current computational methods for CDR design utilize reconstruction losses and do not jointly optimize binding energy, a crucial metric for antibody efficacy. Rather, binding energy optimization is done through computationally expensive Online Reinforcement Learning (RL) pipelines rely heavily on unreliable binding energy estimators. In this paper, we propose AbFlowNet, a novel generative framework that integrates GFlowNet with Diffusion models. By framing each diffusion step as a state in the GFlowNet framework, AbFlowNet jointly optimizes standard diffusion losses and binding energy by directly incorporating energy signals into the training process, thereby unifying diffusion and reward optimization in a single procedure. translated_title: AbFlowNet：通过扩散模型与GFlowNet融合优化抗体-抗原结合能
translated_abstract: 互补决定区（CDRs）是抗体中促进与特定抗原结合的关键片段。目前用于CDR设计的计算方法仅采用重构损失，并未联合优化结合能——而结合能是衡量抗体效力的关键指标。现有的结合能优化通常通过计算代价高昂的在线强化学习（RL）流程来实现，且这些流程严重依赖不可靠的结合能估计器。本文提出了AbFlowNet，一种将GFlowNet与扩散模型相融合的新型生成框架。通过将每个扩散步骤视为GFlowNet框架中的一个状态，AbFlowNet将能量信号直接融入训练过程，从而联合优化标准扩散损失与结合能，在单一流程中统一了扩散优化与奖励优化。实验结果表明，AbFlowNet的表现优于基础扩散模型……
tldr: AbFlowNet提出了一种将GFlowNet与扩散模型融合的新型生成框架，通过将每个扩散步骤建模为GFlowNet中的状态，在单一训练流程中直接引入能量信号，实现扩散损失与抗体-抗原结合能的联合优化，从而避免了依赖不可靠估计器的昂贵在线强化学习流程。
